hypothesis: Improved structural beliefs must influence the immediate expected gain of attacking an unknown piece, not merely the sampled continuation after that immediate outcome is subtracted.

source_algebra.teacher: tools/teacher_bot.py: correction=clip(E[future]-E[immediate]-E[reference]+credit). src/native/teacher_rollout.c: an unknown Flag capture sets immediate=future=WIN-initial, so that sampled terminal immediate outcome cancels from the residual.
source_algebra.native: src/core/ai.c survey()/expected(): hidden ranks equal initial counts minus public losses and live disclosed ranks; unmoved attacks use the global hidden rank proportions, moved targets exclude Flag/Bomb. Baseline defines do not activate AI_OCCUPANCY_BELIEFS.
source_algebra.adjustment: For unknown capture(a,s), add truncate(sum_r P(r_at_s|public_history)*gain(a,r)) minus the exact native integer expected(a,moved). Keep all other score terms and the existing rollout residual unchanged.
source_algebra.quantization: Native integer division truncates toward zero. Analytic posterior expectations use the same quantization, with only a tiny floating-point guard at exact integer boundaries.
source_algebra.scope_limit: This replaces a direct expected-capture-gain component additively. Native plan() goal selection, danger and defense calculations, the conditional near-own-Flag score>=0 bonus, mission scores and student corrections remain fixed. It is not exact recomputation of the whole native evaluator.

scientific_rationale.source: Kaelbling, Littman and Cassandra (1998), Planning and acting in partially observable stochastic domains, section3.4, page108
scientific_rationale.principle: The immediate reward in belief space averages the underlying reward under the current belief, rather than an unrelated count prior. This motivates the component adjustment; it does not prove the full heuristic Stratego policy is optimal or stronger.

two_controls.counts: Condition the remaining Flag/Bomb counts on unmoved hidden slots; allocate remaining mobile ranks exchangeably across all mobile slots. This isolates correcting the native global-count occupancy approximation.
two_controls.joint: Average exact Flag and weighted Bomb-subset marginals over the frozen joint setup-style posterior, then allocate remaining mobile ranks exchangeably.
two_controls.shared: Both use exactly the frozen joint model's eight sampled continuation worlds, four-ply native search, correction blend and native policy. No world sampler or model weights are changed. Analytic root marginals omit behavioral encounter likelihoods in BOTH controls.
two_controls.bomb_inclusion: Conditional on style z and Flag f, a remaining Bomb subset has weights exp(theta_z*adjacent(f,s)). A site's inclusion probability is its weight times the size(k-1) subset partition excluding the site, divided by the size(k) full partition.

native_gain_contract.miner: Worth40 while any enemy Bomb remains, otherwise25.
native_gain_contract.spy: Worth15 if the enemy Marshal is eliminated, otherwise100.
native_gain_contract.flag: An attack on Flag contributes2000 in the native gain table.
native_gain_contract.equal_exchange: Both same-rank pieces disappear; equal worths cancel to0.
native_gain_contract.quiet_known_wins: Quiet moves, already disclosed targets and native forced wins receive no adjustment.

verification: Seven tests pass: exact immobile enumeration, full mobile-rank assignment enumeration, uniform joint equals count-conditioned control, inventory conservation, hidden-nibble/RNG/model invariance, preserved quiet/known/win handling, dynamic specialist rules, and eighty public-inventory comparisons against the original frozen native C expected-gain routine.
